verdict.rationale: Figma's pricing page lists publishing resources across teams and centralizing libraries across departments. The library analytics endpoints confirm that a library's components are used as instances across files and track actions on them, so cross-file publishing is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents how source changes reach consuming files in a controlled way, such as reviewing or accepting library updates. Missing for 10: documentation of the controlled update flow (review/accept library changes), explicit evidence that styles are published alongside components, in-depth first-party library docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
